human_foes.how: 2 foes per sheet (rows), parts head (face blanked with hface.blank), torso, armA, armB, legA, legB; cut as human@<foe>.<part> with build.rig_parts(render, 2, 6, ...), then each of the 8 head variants is the painted blank head with hface.features() laid over it.

v2.how: Second pass in the painted player model style (tools/art/pending/player_parts.webp as the style reference, uploaded as style_player.png): each sheet takes the player style as the first reference and the old layout sheet as the second, described from each foe or boss name, habitat and title card; cut with build.rig_parts(..., loose=True) (row_stickers), since the pieces rarely keep to a grid.

frames.how: Whole-body frame sheets, one render per character so the frames share a scale: the character's whole painted cut-out (or its drawn still, for townsfolk) as the first reference and a painted style sheet as the second; cut with build.blobs() and build.frame_set(name, {frame: figure index}). Cut per piece, stretched to the drawn layer's size, mirrored where the render faced the wrong way.

partners.how: One render per partner (Nano Banana Pro, 21:9, 2k): the partner's drawn still (rigPic of p_<key>, 4x on light grey) as the first reference and a strip of painted rig art (the Guide, the bat, the frostpuff, the Fold Fox, the snowlet, the crumple, the Angler) as the second. Cut with tools/art/partners.py <renders dir> (lumi.png, snip.png, smudge.png, ember.png).
partners.lumi: An animation sprite sheet for Lumi, a friendly paper lantern spirit companion in a 2D papercraft adventure game in the style of Paper Mario. Design from the FIRST reference: a round yellow paper lantern with vertical ribs, dark red caps on top and bottom, a short brown hanging string on top, a cute face with two black dot eyes, a small smile and pink cheeks. Paint it in the style of the SECOND reference: soft painted shading, thick dark plum ink outline, cream paper sticker border, cute chibi proportions. Four frames in ONE horizontal row, evenly spaced, the same size and scale in every frame, whole lantern visible, facing the viewer: 1. Idle, gentle smile. 2. Blink: exactly frame 1 but with eyes closed as short curved lines. 3. Flare: the same lantern glowing brighter with warm light rays around it, eyes squeezed shut happily, mouth open. 4. Cheer: joyful, eyes as happy arcs, big open smile, tilted slightly. IMPORTANT: the lantern's shape, colours and size stay the same in every frame. Plain flat light grey background, no ground line, no shadows, no text, no ghost or faded copies.
